'''Pontifex''' was a title held by a member of the [[Brotherhood of Cognizance]], a religious order on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Maxiron Agolerga/Legends|Maxiron Agolerga]], a Naboo holyman, held the title during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|maxironagolerga|Agolerga, Pontifex Maxiron}}</ref>

{{Deity-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The word ''[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pontifex_Maximus Pontifex]'' has its origins in the Roman republic.
